notes: Deepest-first cascade DELETE of an Entidade's whole structure. A DELETE has no field-level body, so the direct-CRUD deletes are represented as 'invokes' (deleteDirect:<Concept>, all confirmed present in the live invocations catalog) rather than 'writes', which is for field-level mutations. Dropped 'identity::Role.name'/'workspace::Menu.label' shell.js false positives from the draft; added the read fields the draft's IDENT-token matching missed (Entidade.nome/tipo, Armazem.entidadeId, LocalArmazenagem.ruaId, RankingRua.ruaId) by reading the actual filter predicates in excluirEstabelecimento().
